{{Quote|This places stinks of the working classes. It will hide the smell of treason.|Irm-Drocubac, to the other conspirators|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
'''Nemrileo irm-Drocubac''' was a [[Tanjayan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tanjay IV]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Irm-Drocubac had a [[Irm-Drocubac family|family]], which included a [[Nemrileo irm-Drocubac's wife|wife]] and [[Unidentified child 1 (Nemrileo irm-Drocubac)|two]] [[Unidentified child 2 (Nemrileo irm-Drocubac)|children]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the senator was involved in [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai's]] plot to have the planet [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. His involvement in the plot led to him being [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] loyal to the Separatist movement, who sabotaged a [[Unidentified heavy-equipment delivery vehicle|delivery vehicle]], causing it to crash with his [[Airspeeder/Legends|aircar]], although the crash was later blamed on equipment failure.

==Biography==
{{Quote|When they learn what has happened to Tarn Uliss, after what happened to Nemrileo of Tanjay, I don't think any of the others will give us any more trouble.|[[Ansionian]] Senator [[Mousul]], to Shu Mai|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
[[File:Ansion-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|irm-Drocubac was part of a plot to have Ansion secede from the Republic.]]
Nemrileo irm-Drocubac was a [[Tanjayan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who represented his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tanjay IV]] as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Irm-Drocubac began working on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="The Approaching Storm" /> in [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]]<ref name="Senator">''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' states irm-Drocubac had lived and worked on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 15 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to his [[Death/Legends|death]], and ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' puts the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], meaning he served since [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]].</ref> and had lived on world since. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], in which many [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] left the Republic to form the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], irm-Drocubac had a [[Nemrileo irm-Drocubac's wife|wife]], [[Unidentified child 1 (Nemrileo irm-Drocubac)|two]] [[Unidentified child 2 (Nemrileo irm-Drocubac)|children]], and resided in a suburb in the [[Bindai District]] on Coruscant.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

In 22 BBY,<ref name="TERC" /> irm-Drocubac was a part of [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai's]] plot to have the planet [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] secede from the Republic. During a meeting with several other conspirators, irm-Drocubac expressed his doubts regarding Mai's loyalty to the cause, as well as his concerns about Ansion's secession. While he was later traveling in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|aircar]] in the south quadrant of Coruscant, [[S-93 Area|section ninety-three]] near the suburb where he resided, irm-Drocubac was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by agents loyal to the Separatist cause. The agents [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] a [[Unidentified heavy-equipment delivery vehicle|heavy-equipment delivery vehicle]], causing it to collide with his aircar, although the crash was officially attributed to internal guidance software failure in the delivery vehicle.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" /><ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|121|irm-Drocubac, Nemrileo}}</ref>

Irm-Drocubac's death, combined with the later death of [[Tam Uliss]], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] industrialist, served as a message to others in the Separatist movement who doubted Mai's loyalty to the cause. After his death, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was scheduled to deliver his eulogy, and irm-Drocubac's ashes were to be scattered above [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], in accordance with Tanjay tradition.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" /><ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|121|irm-Drocubac, Nemrileo}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You talk of committing treason against the treasoners. Don't get your loyalties confused, Nemrileo. Now is not the time.''"<br />"''You don't have to tell me about time. But this Ansion business is beginning to worry me.|Senator Mousul and Nemrileo irm-Drocubac|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
Nemrileo irm-Drocubac was openly disdainful of the common being, despite the fact his lifestyle was based upon their productivity. He was well respected by his colleagues, co-workers and supporters on his homeworld. Despite being a Republic senator, irm-Drocubac knowingly committed [[Treason/Legends|treason]] by being part of a Separatist conspiracy. irm-Drocubac was also known to distrust Shu Mai's loyalty to the Separatist cause, and had concerns regarding Ansion's secession.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nemrileo irm-Drocubac first appeared in the [[2002]] novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />
